scope: Nationwide weather, official warnings, agriculture, aviation, marine, hydrology and climate; Gujarat is the first answer demonstration.

cases.next_gate: Broader geographic applicability and publisher run/freshness evidence; the six-point replay is not nationwide coverage.
Measure sustained cycles and source freshness; current tests cover bounded retrieval age and explicit failed-refresh reporting.
Complete source timing, current administrative mapping, feed completeness and update/cancel lifecycle.
Reviewed document extraction with place, crop/stage, source issue/expiry and activity context.

cases.acceptance_question: What do applicable airport and en-route products say for the selected route and interval?
cases.next_gate: A dedicated specialist evidence contract and completeness checks; METAR/TAF samples alone are insufficient.

cases.acceptance_question: What do applicable official marine bulletins and model products say for this sea region and interval?
cases.next_gate: Structured official geography/validity and the required wind, sea and warning products; land forecasts cannot substitute.
Named river/gauge mapping, observed hydrology, exposure and validated impact interpretation.
Use existing deterministic historical tools; preserve missingness, spatial comparability, source reconciliation and permitted-use gates.
Evaluate place names, numbers, units, time and negation; the current question parser is explicitly English only.
